findings.body: The overlay's comment explains that `GLIBC_TUNABLES` is the real mitigation but a shim is still required to stop the image refusing to start. The `mongod` service gets both the entrypoint override and the environment variable, but `mongo-secrets` only gets the environment variable. If `mongo-secrets` uses the same MongoDB image (likely, given its name and the base compose), its default entrypoint will still hit the kernel version check and refuse to start, causing `docker compose up` to fail on the affected kernels this file is meant to support. The fix is to apply the same entrypoint override to `mongo-secrets` (or otherwise ensure its image entrypoint is bypassed).
findings.title: Also bypass image refusal for mongo-secrets service

value.summary: The overlay sets the GLIBC tunable and bypasses the image refusal for the mongod service, but it omits the same entrypoint override for mongo-secrets, so the database setup will still fail on affected kernels.
